verdict.rationale: Data-use controls are a fair question for a cloud generative-AI platform like Runway, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, a data-retention policy, or any commitment not to train on user uploads or generations. Mentions of private workflow endpoints and community concerns about uploading to the cloud are about other things and do not show a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
